name: Detachrin
description: Detachrin is a dissociative compound derived from modified ketamine analogs and SNT-disrupting peptides, engineered to create a profound and pleasant separation between the user's sense of self and their physical body — including their chrome. Users describe the experience as floating above or behind their body, watching it operate without being trapped inside it. For heavily augmented individuals, Detachrin dissolves the feeling of being part-machine.
effects: Complete somatic dissociation — body feels external, distant, or absent
Dissolution of chrome-awareness and body dysphoria
Sense of being pure mind, unburdened by flesh or metal
side_effects: Inability to control augmentations during dissociation — chrome operates on autonomic routines only
Falls and physical injury from impaired proprioception
Psychological destabilization in users with existing identity disorders
Rare: dissociation fails to resolve — user remains partially detached for days
Post-use hypersensitivity to body awareness (everything feels too present, too physical)
cultural_context: Detachrin is the drug of people who hate living in their bodies — which in GLMZ means people with cheap, poorly integrated chrome that aches and misfires, people with body dysmorphia who can't afford the geneware to fix it, people who've taken on so much augmentation for work that they've forgotten what it felt like to just be a person. On the Shelf it's called The Shell — you leave the shell behind for a few hours. Nightshade produces it in vapor cartridges that officially treat 'augmentation integration anxiety,' a diagnosis that exists almost entirely to give Detachrin a legal paper trail.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 dock worker with mandatory industrial chrome — mandated by his employer, not chosen — has been on Detachrin nightly for six months; his chrome maintenance has been neglected to the point of mechanical failure risk, and he doesn't care enough to stop

A Nightshade researcher has developed a Detachrin formulation that works on SNT-augmented users specifically — it doesn't just dissociate them from their bodies, it temporarily severs the SNT bridges, and she's not sure what that means for the user's sense of continuity
Someone is using Detachrin strategically — dosing targets before an operation so their chrome goes autonomic-only, making heavily augmented security personnel temporarily harmless
